author: CMS-HGCAL
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds DQM plugins for HGCAL and runs them in the HGCAL test beam workflow 77. It depends on https://github.com/cms-data/Geometry-HGCalMapping/pull/8, which adds the DQM geometry templates and the quality threshold JSON under `Geometry/HGCalMapping/data/DQM`.

##### DQM clients
- `HGCalFastStreamDQM`: FED / ECON-D packet info and unpacker flags
- `HGCalDigiDQM`: per-channel digi monitoring (prescaled)
- `HGCalRecHitDQM`: SoA rechit monitoring
- `HGCalLayerClusterDQM`: SoA layer cluster monitoring

##### Harvesting
- `HGCalDQMHarvester` drives several workers (quality, channel, LS, and FED) that build the summary plots, including polygonal module maps from geometry templates.
- ECON-D quality grading uses thresholds from `dqm_quality_threshold.json`.

##### Workflow 77 (HGCal_TestBeam)
- The DQM sources run after the test beam local reco, and their output is written as DQMIO (`step1_inDQM.root`).
- A new step, `HARVEST_HGCal_TestBeam`, runs the harvester and produces `DQM_V0001_R*.root`.
- The geometry, mapping, and module configuration setup moves into `setupConditionsForSep2024TB`, so the reco step and the harvesting step share it.

##### Trigger primitive DQM (follow-up)
The TPG DQM client (`HGCalTPGDQM`) is not included here. It depends on the HGCAL trigger unpacker data formats (`HGCalECONTPacketInfo`, `HGCalFEDTriggerPacketInfo`), which are not yet in the release, and it will come in a follow-up PR. Until then, the harvester's trigger worker (`HGCalTriggerWorker`) is disabled (`SkipTriggerDQM` defaults to true).


#### PR validation:
- The code was developed and validated in `CMSSW_20_1_0_pre2` with the HGCAL DPG development recipe, and cherry-picked to `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-01-2300`.
- Unit test `testHGCalDQMClients` passes.
- `runTheMatrix.py -l 77` passes both steps:
    - Step 1 writes the HGCAL MEs to `step1_inDQM.root`.
    - The harvesting step produces `DQM_V0001_R*.root` with the HGCAL summary plots.
    - No errors or exceptions in either log.


#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport.
title: Add DQM plugins for HGCAL
